summary: ansible-core 2.21 changes the psrp negotiate_service default from WSMAN to host for the Kerberos SPN, matching native PSRemoting; set ansible_psrp_negotiate_service=WSMAN to revert.
questions: Why does Kerberos with psrp behave differently in Ansible 14?
What SPN does the psrp connection use by default now?
How do I make psrp use the WSMAN SPN again?

answer_card.title: psrp negotiate_service now defaults to host
answer_card.answer_md:
The `psrp` connection's `negotiate_service`, used to build the Kerberos Service Principal Name, now defaults to **`host`** instead of `WSMAN`. This matches the native Windows PSRemoting client and lets Kerberos work with more targets by default. There was no deprecation period.

To restore the old behavior, set in host vars:

```yaml
ansible_psrp_negotiate_service: WSMAN
```
